newsitem.title: LEBANON: Bank Audi continue price rally in Beirut.
newsitem.headline: Bank Audi continue price rally in Beirut.

text.p: Banque Audi stocks continued a price rally on Tuesday on the Beirut Stock Exchange reaching $18 from $17.25 on sharply increased turnover.
Banque Libanaise pour le Commerce, the only other bank trading on the BSE, held steady at $12.625.
Turnover in Banque Audi jumped to 110,400 shares from 26,699 on Monday and BLC turnover fell to a mere 392 shares from 7,000.
Solidere A shares held steady at $10.25 -- an all time low which they last hit on January 17. Solidere B shares were also unchanged at $10.75.
Total BSE turnover was 217,582 shares for a value of $3,095,917 against 155,222 shares and $1,710,049.25 on Monday.
There was no trade in the four other listed firms: Ciments Blancs, Ciments Libanais shares, Eternit and Uniceramic.
The BLOM index rose 0.12 percent to 896.41 and the LISPI index rose 0.43 percent to 81.73.
